claims.claim: Jewellery segment contributes over 85 percent of revenue via Tanishq brand
Watches and wearables segment contributes smaller but growing share
Eyewear segment through Titan Eye Plus stores growing
EBIT margins in jewellery approximately 11 to 12 percent
Largest listed jewellery retailer in India by revenue
Tata Group holds majority stake through Tata Sons
Listed on NSE and BSE exchanges
Tanishq brand targets middle and upper middle class wedding jewellery buyers
Gold price fluctuations impact both revenue and margins significantly
Competing with unorganised local jewellers who dominate most of market
International business in Middle East and Southeast Asia growing
